name: PLC Log & วPA Portfolio
idea: Transcribes teachers' Professional Learning Community meetings into the PLC log format schools must keep and tallies hours per teacher.
twist: Links PLC outcomes to each teacher's performance agreement (วPA) indicators so evidence is ready for academic-standing review.
sources: MeetMate (VNPT AI Hackathon 2025 (The Dreamer track), Vietnam, 3rd) — Meeting assistant that transcribes discussions in real time and generates summaries of decisions and action items.

name: เซอร์เวย์ Copilot · motor claim surveyor
idea: Guides a motor-insurance surveyor at a crash scene through photos, the claim form and fault notes for a voluntary policy claim.
twist: Compares new damage photos with earlier claims on the same plate to flag reused or pre-existing damage.
sources: InsureScan (Alibaba Cloud AI Hackathon Malaysia 2025, 1st) — AI that analyses claim documents and images to detect vehicle damage and assess claim validity, speeding up insurance claims and resisting fraud.

name: IPD Benefit Reasoner
idea: Reads a Thai health policy's inpatient benefit schedule and a hospital bill, deciding line by line what is payable and why.
twist: Asks clarifying questions about waiting periods or pre-existing conditions before concluding, then explains denials in plain Thai.
sources: The Hammurabi (Stanford LLM x Law Hackathon Fall 2024, Best VC, Stanford) — AI platform that reasons through insurance contract logic to determine outcomes for specific scenarios, asking clarifying questions before concluding.

name: Agent Needs-Analysis Checker
idea: Turns life-insurance policy wordings into structured benefits so an insurance agent can compare plans for a specific customer.
twist: Generates the customer needs-analysis record and flags when the recommended plan does not match stated needs.
sources: ActuaViz (MAS Global FinTech Hackcelerator 2025, winner, Singapore FinTech Festival) — Converts complex insurance product documents into machine-readable formats to automate product comparison, chatbot support and pricing simulation.

name: อู่ในเครือ Estimate Auditor
idea: Checks a partner garage's repair estimate line by line against damage photos, parts price lists and labour rates before insurer approval.
twist: Questions repair-versus-replace choices and parts listed outside the damaged zone shown in photos.
sources: ClaimGuardian 360 (UiPath AgentHack 2025 (global, online), Enterprise Agents 2nd place (team Rakshak AI)) — Agentic claims management solution for processing insurance claims.

Agent Halo Agent Networks (Salesforce TDX 2025 Agentforce Hackathon, San Francisco, 1st place) — Agentforce agent network connecting insurers, repair shops and emergency responders to remove delays in the customer claims journey.

name: บิลค่าไฟ Dispute Desk
idea: Helps electricity-authority district office staff explain a disputed high bill using meter history, tariff type, Ft period and read status.
twist: Detects estimated-read catch-ups and meter-reading transcription errors before sending a technician out.
sources: Energy Agent AI (Agent Development Kit Hackathon with Google Cloud 2025 (online), North America winner) — Multi-agent system that transforms energy-utility customer management using Google ADK orchestration.

name: Feeder Fault Locator
idea: Combines customer outage calls, recloser events and weather to estimate which section of a distribution feeder has faulted.
twist: Drafts the switching order for the line crew following safety procedure but requires the duty engineer's approval.
sources: Project LUCID (SAS Hackathon 2025, Global Champion Industry Energy Track) — AI energy analytics system using IoT, forecasting, anomaly detection and digital twins to improve grid resilience and renewable usage.

name: Designated Factory Energy Report
idea: Compiles a designated factory's meter data into the annual energy management report its energy manager must submit.
twist: Checks claimed savings against measured data and drafts next year's measures with payback calculations.
sources: WiseWatts (CleanTech Hackathon 2025 (ENERGY EXPO), 2nd place, Bucharest) — 24/7 AI co-pilot that optimises energy consumption and integrates renewable sources.

name: Dangerous Goods Pre-Loading Check
idea: Checks truck and container loading plans at a port for dangerous-goods class segregation, placards and documents before loading.
twist: Generates the emergency response card responders would need if that exact load spilled on the highway.
sources: PLACI (KaiTETHON 2026 (Kale Logistics Solutions), overall winner, Mumbai) — AI pre-loading cargo risk analyst that analyses advance cargo information to flag risks before loading.

name: 1669 Dispatch Coder
idea: Guides an emergency medical dispatcher through Thai criteria-based dispatch questions to assign red, yellow or green priority.
twist: Picks the right response unit level and gives the caller pre-arrival first-aid instructions in plain Thai.
sources: Triage (MSIT AI Challenge & Hackathon 2025, Korea, Excellence Award) — Conversational AI agent service that predicts emergency patient needs and improves emergency-care management efficiency.

Rescue Master - Citizen Edition v2.0 (Cloud Intelligence Rising: Taiwan Generative AI Application Hackathon 2025 (DIGITIMES x AWS), 1st) — Disaster app that guides untrained citizens through START triage and basic first aid during mass-casualty events.

name: ใบขนสินค้า Prep for customs brokers
idea: Reads emailed invoices, packing lists and bills of lading and drafts import declaration fields for a customs broker to verify.
twist: Flags quantity, weight and value mismatches across the three documents before the declaration is lodged.
sources: CAIRGO (Microsoft Agentic AI Hackathon 2025 (Microsoft Taiwan x MODA), Taiwan, 1st) — China Airlines cargo agent that reads emailed booking orders and Excel/PDF attachments and enters bookings into the system so staff only verify them.

name: กรรมการตรวจรับ · works acceptance check
idea: Helps a local government's works inspection committee check each instalment claim against the BOQ, schedule and site photos.
twist: Flags instalments claimed without photo evidence of hidden works, such as rebar before a concrete pour.
sources: SafeContractor (BU Spark! Civic Tech Hackathon 2025, Overall Winner, Boston) — Database where Boston residents verify contractor credentials from public records, with AI-generated summaries to avoid fraud.

name: Annual Building Inspection Report
idea: Drafts the annual safety inspection report for large or public buildings from a licensed inspector's checklist photos.
twist: Tracks defects from last year's report and escalates unfixed fire-safety items first.
sources: MaestrIA (Anthropic Built with Opus 4.7 Claude Code Hackathon 2026 (virtual), Keep Thinking Prize) — Home repair diagnostic tool that gives cost/time estimates and connects users with local skilled tradespeople.

name: จป. Lift Plan Check
idea: Lets a construction safety officer check crane lift plans for load chart, radius and rigging, plus worker lifting postures in photos.
twist: Generates the morning toolbox talk in Thai, Burmese and Khmer for that day's specific lifts.
sources: Lifting Risk Analysis (Super AI Engineer: 5th National AI Exhibition 2025, Thailand, Best AI Innovation Award) — AI system that analyses the injury risk of improper postures when workers lift items.

name: Hotel Night Audit & TM.30
idea: Reconciles a small hotel's front-desk, POS and payment records each night and prepares foreign-guest residence notifications for immigration.
twist: Spots room revenue without a matching guest registration, a common sign of leakage or unreported guests.
sources: Tax Aggregation Model (Oxford Legal Tech Hackathon 2026 (BRYTER & Reed Smith), 1st place, Oxford) — Collects tax data from two companies in an M&A deal, normalises it into a unified tax schema and stores it for tax risk management.
